selection_policy.name: source-grounded-recurrence-tracer-v1
inclusions: Exact source spans reviewed for repeated implementation structure and bound to collected operator occurrences.
Only normalized structure directly supported by at least two distinct implementation IDs and Git blobs.
exclusions: No semantic observation is inferred solely from pre-tagged operator-library mechanism labels.
No upstream source, generated artifact, benchmark output, or tuning result is copied into this extraction.
deviations: Native Metal structure is retained instead of normalizing every implementation to CUDA, preserving Apple-target facts for this local study.
non_claims: This in-progress tracer is not an exhaustive abstraction extraction over the collected corpus.
A source pattern is not an admitted compiler IR operation or Target contract.
No Schedule expressibility, correctness, calibration, or performance result follows from extraction.
Passing an index and accessed-buffer extent to the observed offset_neg_idx helper is not a bounds check; no in-bounds or memory-safety result follows.
No race freedom, destination ownership, atomic conflict policy, determinism, overwrite or reduction semantics, or update ordering follows from the runtime-index address-fold recurrence.

The runtime-index address-fold recurrence does not establish equivalence to Compiler AccessIndexKind.BUFFER, mask_tiled_axes zero-fill behavior, accessed-buffer boundary analysis, or any admitted lowering subset.

The two-pass row RMS recurrence does not establish a common thread or SIMDgroup ownership model, reduction order, floating-point reproducibility, launch topology, synchronization contract, physical row residency, or memory-traffic and performance result.

The recurrence does not normalize fixed versus runtime row extents, layer-slot addressing, zero-centered versus direct normalization-weight factors, the GDN projected SiLU gate, bounds handling, output layout, aliasing, or memory safety.
The recurrence is independent of hierarchical-simdgroup-threadgroup-reduction and does not admit a Compiler RMS operation, Target capability, Schedule form, or lowering subset.
